subject: Executive Roundtable: Briefing + Rapid Fact Sheet (draft for review)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Executive Roundtable: Briefing + Rapid Fact Sheet (draft for review)

Team —

Acme confirmed the October executive roundtable (panel + short vendor demos). They asked for a 1-page briefing for their SVP attendees and a separate 1-page rapid fact sheet we can hand to panelists. I’ve attached drafts: RDW-Exec-Roundtable-Brief-v1.pdf (audience + suggested talking points) and RDW-Rapid-Fact-Sheet-onepager-v1.pdf (stats, privacy bullets, and quick tech wins).

Two asks:
- Laura / Jonas: please do a content scrub — tighten the opening paragraph to make the value prop clearer for non-technical SVPs and remove the long-form bullet about quantization details (keep a 1-line note).
- Marissa: can you confirm production specs for the one-pager and whether we can do a printed handout (qty 75) vs. single-sheet inserts at the event? Also we’ll need a 1-paragraph bio (100 words) for the panel moderator slot.

Also adding a short live demo (~6–8 minutes) into the flow. Draft demo script attached (RDW-8min-demo-script-v2.docx). Please highlight any timing risks; we need a final script by next Wednesday (2026-09-06) so we can rehearse with Sarah (Acme) the week of 9/14.

I’ll coordinate the final layout with design once the copy is locked. If you can reply with redlines in-line or comments in Drive by EOD Monday that would be great.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: RDW-Exec-Roundtable-Brief-v1.pdf, RDW-Rapid-Fact-Sheet-onepager-v1.pdf, RDW-8min-demo-script-v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable: Briefing + Rapid Fact Sheet (draft for review)

Michael — thanks for the draft. Quick read-through here:

- Opening paragraph: suggested new first sentence: 'Redwood Inference helps engineering-led teams deploy production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and lower unit cost.' That frames the ask for SVP-level decision makers.
- Remove the quantization deep-dive (agree). Add a single parenthetical: '(see technical appendix for engineers)'.
- Panel bio: I drafted a 90-word bio for our moderator (see below) — Michael, you can edit.

Moderator bio (90 words):
Laura Bennett is Director of Field Marketing at Redwood Inference, leading partner events and executive programs. Her work focuses on translating technical capabilities into business outcomes for enterprise teams, with a background in product marketing and developer evangelism. Laura works closely with customers to shape proof points and operational playbooks for scalable LLM deployments.

I’ll push my line edits into the Drive doc now. Marissa — on print: we can print 75 single-sheet color one-pagers on silk, but we should keep margins minimal so we can fit a quick fold for pocket distribution.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Field Marketing
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-08-30T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable: Briefing + Rapid Fact Sheet (draft for review)

Thanks — I pushed print specs into the Drive note. Quick logistics:
- Print: 75 one-pagers, 1-side full color, 100lb silk, bleed-safe. Lead time 6 business days from approval. Cost estimate ~$95 for 75 (local shop).
- We can also produce a 1-sheet insert (folded) to include the 8-min demo highlights. If we do the fold option we need to finalize copy by 09/03 to meet print cutoff.
- Bio: Laura’s looks great; I trimmed to 80 words in the Drive comment.
- On rehearsal: I can coordinate a 30-minute dry run with Acme (Sarah) on 9/16 AM. We should have the final script and one-pager locked by 9/06 as Michael asked.

Also noted some timing risk in the demo script: slide 3 requires a live model call that could add 40–60s if network is slow. Recommend we prepare a pre-recorded clip as a fallback (I marked the script where a pre-recorded clip should sit).

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable: Briefing + Rapid Fact Sheet (draft for review)

Hi Michael / team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the drafts. A few notes from Acme events:

- Panelist acceptance: confirmed. We’ll need the 1-pager by 09/10 for internal distribution to SVPs.
- Demo timing: could we compress the live demo to 6 minutes? Our agenda is tight. If you can hit the core outcome + one short live interaction, that would be ideal.
- Technical contact: please copy our onsite AV lead, Chris Lee (cc’d). For the live call, we need an IP allowlist and a short test window on 9/16 (Marissa — your dry run note works).

One more ask: can you add a top-line data privacy bullet on the fact sheet that says 'No customer data leaves Acme systems; Redwood processes anonymized inputs under contract'? We require that for our legal team.

Thanks — looking forward to the final materials.

Sarah Dunn
Head of Strategic Programs, Acme Corp
sarah.dunn@acmecorp.com
